acquisition method: Mass spectrometry was performed in a positive mode using repetitively full MS scan followed by high collision-induced dissociation (HCD, at 35 normalized collision energy) of the 10 most dominant ions (>1 charges) selected from the first MS scan.
alkylation reagent: modified with 10 mM iodoacetamide in 100 mM ammonium bicarbonate
alkylation concentration: modified with 10 mM iodoacetamide in 100 mM ammonium bicarbonate
cleavage agent: digested in 2 M Urea, 25 mM ammonium bicarbonate with modified trypsin (Promega)
collision energy: high collision-induced dissociation (HCD, at 35 normalized collision energy)
enrichment method: Pellets from three independent samples of pooled vesicles isolated from the brain cortex of WT or Elp1 KD mice
fragmentation method: high collision-induced dissociation (HCD, at 35 normalized collision energy)
instrument: Samples were analyzed by LC-MS/MS using Q Exactive plus mass spectrometer (Thermo)
labeling: The data were quantified by label-free analysis using the same software
reduction reagent: reduced with 3 mM DTT (60 °C for 30 min)
reduction concentration: reduced with 3 mM DTT (60 °C for 30 min)
